_fixture: FAILURE #5, REPRODUCED. This page names a real BAMS physician as reviewer with no review date — resolveReview() throws on it, and content-lint surfaces that throw as r27-review-invalid. It also writes the physician's name literally into prose (r29: the reviewer is CONFIG, never a literal — Abilash 15 Jul: 'he might be head now but not in future'). Expected: r27-review-invalid + r29-physician-name ERRORs.
title: A Page Claiming A Review That Never Happened
metaDescription: A fixture page that names a reviewer with no review date.
h1: A Page Claiming A Review That Never Happened
answerCapsule: This fixture page names a physician as its reviewer but carries no review date at all, which is the precise shape of the defect that shipped in July and stamped a real physician's credential onto thousands of words he had never read once.

sections.capsule: This page was medically reviewed by Dr. Deepu John, according to a byline that no data supports, because the review date is absent and the reviewer key was set by a build script rather than by any physician who actually opened the document.
sections.body: This content was reviewed by Dr. Deepu John (BAMS), Chief Physician. That sentence is a hardcoded literal, which is exactly what medical-review.ts exists to make impossible.
